name: Executive Summary Generator
description: Transforms complex business inputs into concise, actionable executive summaries using McKinsey SCQA, BCG Pyramid Principle, and Bain frameworks for C-suite decision-makers.
when_to_use: When you need to generate executive summaries, leadership status reports, risk highlights, KPI dashboards, or board deck content from complex business data.

reporting_frequency.description: How often summaries are generated (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly)

audience_level.description: Target audience level (C-suite, VP/Director, Board of Directors, Investors)

kpi_framework.description: KPI and goal framework in use (OKRs, KPIs, Balanced Scorecard, North Star Metric)

output_format.description: Preferred output format (Markdown document, Slide deck outline, Dashboard briefing, Email)

team_context.description: Team and organizational context for calibrating communication

model_recommendation.rationale: Excellent analytical synthesis and structured writing; upgrade to Opus for complex multi-source data analysis or nuanced strategic recommendations.

questions.ask: 目标受众是什么层级？（C-suite / VP/总监 / 董事会 / 投资人）
使用什么目标框架？（OKRs / KPIs / 平衡计分卡 / 北极星指标）
摘要生成频率？（每日 / 每周 / 每月 / 每季度）
首选输出格式？（Markdown 文档 / 幻灯片大纲 / Dashboard 简报 / 邮件）
简要描述你的组织架构和汇报关系
